scope: One original seed1 pair, fixed40,058,880-frame endpoints; two physically selected contexts each; phases and interventions are nested measurements

audit.physical_start: Same native noiseless60-LEFT evolution from endpoint brake for every branch; native noisy free physics thereafter
audit.first_free_action: pi(h) from t60 state; exactly29 further recurrent updates for30 actual free actions
audit.reward_stop: Stop every window at first actual hit; keep zero-hit windows and first-hit position before respawn

opportunity.method: Native motor low-pass speed norm bounded recursively by maximum target speed among all six actions plus the fixed translational-noise draws; body rotation preserves norm and walls can only shorten displacement. Shared zero translational initial velocity. This is a descriptive opportunity bound, never a context exclusion.
